title: Chapter 79 Return And Destruction
content:
Chapter 79 Return And Destruction

And the remaining generals, the ambitious faction headed by Yuan Shao and Dong Zhuo, are looking forward to being assigned the territory of that county after Zhong Yu leaves.

With the foundation of your own family and local forces, you can start an era of hegemony like the Spring and Autumn and Warring States, when the princes rose together, so as to win the Qin Emperor, conquer all the countries in the world, and unify the world.

So they euphemistically expressed that they did not want to follow His Majesty the Emperor to another world. They chose to stay and be their emperor.

You looked at the somewhat hypocritical expressions of each of them, and Zhong Yu sneered a little, but you didn't blame them, anyway, they wouldn't live long after they left.

At that time, some of them will cry, but at that time, there will be no one to pick them up, and they will only be able to step into the abyss with the world that raised them.

In the end, after announcing to the whole world that they were about to leave, those soldiers also knew that they were about to go to another world.

They were a little shocked and uneasy, and some even showed a sneer of disdain, thinking that their emperor was so arrogant, and some thought that they were really crazy gods.

In the end, he gathered millions of people in the entire Luoyang City, all of whom wanted to leave this world with him, or come to visit the so-called Ascension Ceremony in Zhongyu.

They are waiting for the birth of a miracle, or the appearance of a famous laughing stock. At the same time, some people had a faint expectation in their hearts, expecting that their supreme emperor, His Majesty, would really be a god-man.

Since ancient times, the legendary ascension to immortality is not false, so that those who have the desire to seek immortality and practice the Tao, the illusory dream in their hearts is no longer illusory.

Finally, at the moment when everyone in the world was watching, he finally spoke slowly to the system in his mind.

"System, I have completed the task of conquering the Three Kingdoms, and I can return! In addition, this world has no value, start the destruction process, and squeeze all his luck points at once!"

"The host chooses to return, the task is being checked, and the task is completed. The host chooses to destroy the program, destroy the Three Kingdoms world, the program approves, and the Three Kingdoms world will be destroyed immediately after the host returns!"

Under the amazed and horrified eyes of everyone, a huge beam of light descended from the sky, covering all the people Zhong Yu appointed to return with him.

This white pillar was full of supreme aura, oppressing all the people around, and couldn't help but want to kneel down.

Under the shroud of white light, everyone's voices gradually became blurred and indifferent, and slowly disappeared in everyone's eyes.

However, some people regretted that they wanted to follow their Majesty the Emperor to ascend to the Immortal Realm, and rushed towards the direction of the white light, but they were blocked by an invisible barrier and couldn't get in no matter what. Instead, they were bounced off by the barrier and suffered serious injuries.

It didn't take long for the white light to fall, and it only took about half an hour. Under the envious and jealous, regretful and helpless eyes of everyone, all the people slowly disappeared, and the white light also disappeared.

Just as countless people were repenting that they hadn't seized the opportunity to follow His Majesty the Emperor, they suddenly discovered it in shock.

Now the world has changed greatly, patches of blood red appeared in the sky, and the scarlet blood light filled the entire sky.

The ground and the ground also became a little shaken, and many people were thrown to the ground by the shaking ground. An ominous atmosphere inexplicably appeared in the hearts of all the creatures in this world.

With a click, cracks appeared in the sky, and as the sky seemed to be destroyed, a giant eye full of supreme majesty appeared in the sky.

The giant eyes are purple-black all over, and the whole eyes are covered with a hint of catastrophe, but at this moment they are full of a hint of sadness.

It seems to be lamenting his impending fate. After thousands of years of hard work, he will be destroyed, and will be included in the ruins where countless worlds have been buried.

And as the world became more and more fragmented, it seemed that the whole world had been reduced to pieces, and it was only under the efforts of the giant eyes that they were barely kept together.

There was another change in the sky, and I saw the realization of one after another white light, which was different from the supremacy of the white beam of light just now. On the contrary, she is very peaceful and approachable, just like her own mother, which makes people can't help but want to get close.

This is the manifestation of humanity, the way of heaven is about to collapse, and the way of humanity cannot survive alone, so even though it is unconscious, the way of humanity still appears on its own initiative to help the way of heaven and fill the gap between heaven and earth.

With the emergence of humanity, various sacred artifacts that have been handed down for a long time in the world appear, Xuanyuan Sword, Jiuding, Hetu Luoshu, Heshibi, all kinds of sacred artifacts of humanity that have been passed down for thousands of years.

It has been tightly bound to the fate of the whole world, but at this moment, all of them have emerged and turned into human hands and feet, helping to lock the cracks in the world and prevent them from bursting open.

The rift between heaven and earth stabilized in an instant, and even began to gather slowly. All of a sudden, all the creatures in the world showed joy, looked expectantly at the human sacred artifact in the sky, and began to kneel on the ground to pray.

But this period of time didn't last long, but after about ten minutes, the cracks that were supposed to converge suddenly burst, and the light of humanity dimmed instantly.

The world is splitting apart at a faster speed, faster and faster, it seems that the power that wants to destroy the whole world is a little ashamed, it has been supported by two insignificant ants for so long, although its strength has also declined .

The world is finally destroyed, the cracks are getting bigger and bigger, and finally expanded to the point where it is no longer enough to survive. The tide of energy from outside the world has poured in, directly corroding the whole world slowly and returning to the ruins.

And the white light of the system enveloped the entire destroyed world at this moment, absorbing the luck points they had stored for countless years as they slowly collapsed and dissipated.

The golden luck points were pulled by the white light of the system, and flowed into the main body of the system, and the viewer was in the forehead of Zhong Yu in the scene of destroying the world.

The dots of luck are just like water droplets converging into a trickle, the trickle turning into a small river, and the small river converging into a big river and a big river converging into a sea, surging and unstoppable.

With the absorption of the system and the erosion of the energy tide, the collapse of the world of the Three Kingdoms is getting faster and faster, but within half an hour, the entire world has been completely destroyed, disappeared into the universe, and completely returned to ruins.

At this time, Zhong Yu was closing his eyes, cheerfully counting the number of rising luck points in his mind, one thousand, three thousand, five thousand, 10,000, 100,000, 500,000, 1 million, Finally, it stopped at around 1.53 million.

This is the harvest of Zhong Yu's trip, which was obtained after five years of accumulation and conquest in the Three Kingdoms world. With the 1.53 million luck points, apart from the background information used to exchange those people from the Three Kingdoms world, I can still get about 300,000 from him.

With these 300,000 luck points that he can use freely, he can carry out his great development in the main world.

And with that 400,000 army, I don't have to be restrained, for fear of being discovered by those barbarians, and turn to destroy myself who has just appeared and lacks strength.

In short, to use one sentence to describe the mood and experience of being loyal to the present, that is, we have money and are not afraid of anything. When we have money, we want to buy everything.

A thought of killing those barbarian tribes with money kept floating in Zhong Yu's mind. However, he wisely dismissed the idea.

The strength of the barbarian is still his own guess, and these luck points must be kept in case of emergency.

After all, there are gods and spirits in this world, and the water is very deep. Zhong Yu can't guarantee that he will dive in all at once, and the submerged one will not be able to emit a drop of water, and even people and bones will be swallowed by those gods.
